text.text_excerpt: I went here recently for a special event and this is truly a lovely venue. It's actually connected to Barcadia and only open Thursday, Friday, and Saturdays. Its atmosphere is very cute! It consists of an Asian decor theme throughout the establishment from tables and statues found throughout. It is definitely a good place to have an event or bring groups if reserved in advance in my opinion. The cocktails menu was pretty impressive but also pretty expensive. If you don't plan to spend 12/15 for a cocktail, this is definitely not the place for you (Thankfully it was an open bar). The cocktails were exceptional. The cocktail that was worth a try was the delicious Tokyo Sour which consisted ...

Pretty cool spot to chill and let loose. I am not sure what nights are the best BUT this is a classic SPOT to make your own PARTY! You bring the friends, I play the music. Last I checked, you can be the dj here and use yours. I think this holds true if you reserve a section. Thank you for being a friend. ..nice menu. I really enjoyed the chicken skewers. The drinks were pretty good, but, I am to the point that if you coach a bartender right, you will get a homerun! Batta, batta, batta, SWING!!

Came here on Saturday night with a group and it was somewhat packed. The bartenders were cool and they were pretty quick with the drink orders. The music was very upbeat but the DJ could've done a better job with the music selection. There's not much to say except it was a good time. Sad to say I forgot to take any photos since I was a bit under the influence.
